current_episode.title: #58 - Laughing Through Life: Hillbilly-Rican Roots & Clean Stand-Up Comedy with Juanita Lolita

guest.bio_context: Juanita Lolita grew up with a hillbilly and Puerto Rican heritage and worked mowing lawns and stocking shelves at Publix supermarket before being signed up for an open mic at a comedy club 13 years ago. She advanced to the finals of Florida's Funniest Person competition in her second time on stage, placing fifth overall. She has since toured with comedian Shawn Wayans, performed on the Sherry Shepard Show in New York City, and established herself as a clean stand-up comedian performing in comedy clubs across the United States.

context.real_quote: I went directly from being an unemployed never comedian to a feature comic because I trusted God and did what he told me to do.

pending_qa.q: Why did Juanita Lolita quit her job at Publix to pursue stand-up comedy?
pending_qa.r: Juanita felt God was calling her to quit her job at Publix and pursue comedy. She prayed about it and kept hearing this message. A missionary at church spoke about God calling people to do things they are not equipped for, and she later heard Dr. Charles Stanley say 'you never retire from doing the will of God.' Her sister eventually supported the decision after hearing her pastor preach about someone God was asking to do something completely different. Her husband also gave permission.

pending_qa.q: What was Juanita Lolita's experience touring with Shawn Wayans?
pending_qa.r: A comedy club in Sarasota asked Juanita to open for Shawn Wayans as they wanted a clean female comic. Later, his original feature comic did not want to continue, so they contacted her to tour with him. Unlike performing solo at comedy clubs where she paid all expenses, touring with Wayans meant the tour paid for everything including flights and hotels. This allowed her to perform in California and across the United States, despite being born and raised in St. Pete, Florida and never having traveled before.
